motivation: The Q84 K=50 flow kernel had mean effective analog sample size 48.72 of 50 and mean weight CV 0.223. This sensitivity test asks whether narrower neighborhoods K=10 or K=20 produce a more locally responsive state-conditioned rule ensemble.
hypothesis: Selecting K from {10,20,50} using Discovery Top-20 mean hits only will identify a flow-state ensemble that improves Blind OOS Top-20 mean hits over the equal-weight 42-rule ensemble by at least 0.10 hits per target, with a positive paired block-bootstrap lower bound and global Holm-adjusted p<0.05 against the uniform Top-20 null.
selection_rule: Select K on Discovery only by highest mean Top-20 hits per target; ties by lower mean actual-number rank, then smaller K. Freeze selected K before Validation and Blind OOS.
controls: K=50 reproduction of the already validated Q84 flow ensemble
PAIR::freq_20>momentum_10_50 (fixed Q84 discovery-selected comparator; descriptive only, excluded from the new inferential family)

registered_test_family.null: Per-target conditional Hypergeometric(40,5,k) number-hit count with the same continuity-corrected normal screen used by Q84; one global Holm-Bonferroni family of 36 tests.

paired_inference.comparisons: Discovery-selected K versus equal-weight ensemble and fixed Q84 comparator on Validation and Blind OOS
paired_inference.interpretation: Descriptive paired intervals only; not part of the 36-test Holm family.

primary_acceptance_gate: selected K Blind OOS mean Top-20 hits >= 2.5
selected K minus equal-weight Blind OOS mean Top-20 hits >= +0.10
paired 95% block-bootstrap lower bound for that Top-20 delta > 0
global Holm-adjusted selected-K Blind OOS Top-20 p-value < 0.05
guardrails: Every target state uses only draws strictly before the target.
Historical state/outcome pairs enter analogue memory only after their target has been scored.
K is selected on Discovery only; Validation and Blind OOS never tune K.
The fixed comparator is descriptive and is not counted as an independent test in the new family.
The K=50 output must reproduce the previously validated Q84 metrics exactly within numerical tolerance.
Historical Blind OOS has prior SONAR exposure and is exploratory, not a virgin holdout.
No model promotion or immutable target-freeze modification.
